constraints.name: takkeu_clear_rules_v1
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((takkeu_rules_version IS NULL) OR ((game_slug = 'takkeu'::text) AND (takkeu_rules_version = ANY (ARRAY['goal-3000-v1'::text, 'goal-3500-v1'::text])))) AND ((NOT takkeu_clear_verified) OR COALESCE((takkeu_rules_version = ANY (ARRAY['goal-3000-v1'::text, 'goal-3500-v1'::text])), false))))

constraints.name: takkeu_final_lost_balls_range_v1
constraints.definition: CHECK (((takkeu_final_lost_balls IS NULL) OR ((game_slug = 'takkeu'::text) AND ((takkeu_final_lost_balls >= 0) AND (takkeu_final_lost_balls <= 100)))))
